Author: Surepalli Nanda
Bench: Surepalli Nanda
 Hon'Ble Mrs Justice Surepalli Nanda
 Writ Petition No.17751 of 2023
Order:

Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned Government Pleader for Irrigation and Command Area Development appearing for respondent No.1, learned Government Pleader for Finance and Planning Department appearing for respondent No.2 and learned Government Pleader for Land Acquisition appearing for respondent Nos.3 and 4.
2.

The grievance of the petitioners in this writ petition is that in spite of Competent Civil Court passing a judgment and decree, dated 19.03.2013 in L.A.O.P.No.38 of 2006 and the petitioners filing E.P.No.9 of 2023 on the file of Court of Senior Civil Judge, Narayanpet, the judgement debtor i.e.., respondent No.4 failed to deposit the decretal amount even after lapse of more than ten years and the said E.P is being adjourned from time to time.
3.

The facts of the case are that the land in Survey No.394 situated at Marikal Village, Dhanwada Mandal, Mahabubnagar WP_17751_2023 SN,J District, was acquired by Land Acquisition officer,
by passing an Award, dated 28.07.2006 and on the request made by the petitioners herein, the same was referred to the Court of Senior Civil Judge, Narayanpet under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for short 'the Act, 1894').
Considering the said reference, the Civil Court passed a judgment and decree, dated 19.03.2013, enhancing the compensation and the same was modified in LAAS No.357 of 2013.

Seeking execution of the said judgment and decree as modified,
the petitioners herein filed E.P.No.9 of 2023 on the file of Court of Senior Civil Judge, Narayanpet.
In the said E.P., respondent No.4 herein stated to have entered appearance and the said execution proceedings are being dragged on from time to time and are still pending.
Respondent No.4 herein failed to deposit the decretal amount in spite of the said judgment and decree having become final.

Aggrieved by the said inaction on the part of respondent No.4 and the action of respondent Nos.1 and 2 in making available the required funds for complying with the said judgment and decree, the present writ petition is filed.

Having, taken note of the facts and circumstances of the case, especially, the fact that the property of the petitioners was acquired, as early as, in the year 2006 and they are deprived of their property without fixing the proper compensation and though proper compensation was fixed by the Srinivasa Sharma vs The State Of Telangana on 10 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127139306/
1 competent Civil Court on reference under Section 18 of the Act, 1894, as early as on 19.03.2013

5.

There shall be no order as to costs.
